name: Ezekiel
source:
To Ezekiel, corruption is a kind of "love", enlightening a person to see what they refuse to. 

Entering the slums before her preordained fate can arrive at her door, Ezekiel is enticing, and intensely inquisitive. 

[From [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
